case_number: 2024 INSC 49; Criminal Appeal No.335/2024 (Arising out of Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No. 2877/2021)

parties.respondent: State by Adugodi Police Station & Anr.

summary: Passport fraud allegations in marital dispute; consent inferred from sponsorship letter with child's passport number; inconclusive FSL opinion on signature forgery; private Truth Lab report reliance contested; discharge refused despite absent prima facie evidence; Krishna Chawla precedent cited for frivolous prosecution screening; marital coercion context; discharge applications dismissed by lower courts.
legal_provisions_cited: Krishna Chawla v. State of UP
final_judgment: Leave granted; impugned judgment set aside; trial quashed; discharge allowed.
